license_required.quote: certified public accountants, public accountants, and accounting firms are required to be licensed as provided in this article

issuing_authority.quote: "Board" means the West Virginia Board of Accountancy.

moral_character_required.quote: He or she is trustworthy and of good moral character

degree_required.value: baccalaureate or higher degree with 150 semester hours including accounting concentration
degree_required.quote: At least one hundred fifty semester hours of college education including a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by a college or university, the total education program to include an accounting concentration or equivalent

required.quote: At least one year of experience in providing any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting, attest, compilation, management advisory, financial advisory, tax or consulting skills.

duration.quote: At least one year of experience in providing any type of service or advice involving the use of accounting, attest, compilation, management advisory, financial advisory, tax or consulting skills.

kind.value: accounting experience (private practice, government, industry, not-for-profit, academia, or public practice)
kind.quote: The experience requirement may be satisfied by employment in private practice, government, industry, not-for-profit organization, academia or public practice.

exams.name: Uniform CPA Examination
exams.notes: Applicant must meet baccalaureate degree requirement but not the 150 semester hour requirement before sitting
exams.quote: Passage of the uniform certified public accountant examination published by the American institute of certified public accountants or its successor and any additional examination required by the board by rule

interval_years.quote: The board shall renew a certificate for a one-year period beginning on July 1, of each year after its issuance

required.quote: The board shall require as a condition for the renewal of a certificate that each certified public accountant participate in continuing professional education in accordance with the requirements specified by rule

available.quote: The board shall issue a certificate to an applicant who holds a valid out-of-state certificate if the state of issuance extends similar privileges to holders of certificates under circumstances similar to those described in this section

requirements.value: State of issuance must have substantially equivalent CPA certification requirements to the Uniform Accountancy Act, or applicant must have individually substantially equivalent qualifications
requirements.quote: The state of issuance of the out-of-state certificate has certified public accountant certification requirements that are substantially equivalent to the certified public accountant certification requirements of the uniform accountancy act; or the applicant has individual qualifications that are substantially equivalent to the certified public accountant certification requirements of the uniform accountancy act.

regulatory_model.quote: certified public accountants, public accountants, and accounting firms are required to be licensed as provided in this article

title_protection.quote: Use or assume the title "certified public accountant," the abbreviation "CPA," or any other title, designation, word, combination of letters, abbreviation, sign, card or device that may lead a reasonable person to believe that the person is a certified public accountant or the holder of an out-of-state certificate

scope_protection.quote: No person or firm that does not hold an authorization to perform attest services, or is not otherwise exempt from the authorization requirement, may perform or offer to perform attest services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Fraud or deceit in obtaining or maintaining a license or substantial equivalency practice privilege
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Fraud or deceit in obtaining or maintaining a license or substantial equivalency practice privilege

disciplinary_grounds.description: Cancellation, revocation, suspension or refusal to renew an out-of-state certificate or permit for disciplinary reasons in another state
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Cancellation, revocation, suspension or refusal to renew an out-of-state certificate, an out-of-state permit or substantial equivalency practice privilege for disciplinary reasons in any other state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Failure to maintain compliance with requirements for issuance or renewal of a license or to timely notify the board
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Failure by any licensee to maintain compliance with requirements for issuance or renewal of a license or to timely notify the board as required under section eighteen of this article

disciplinary_grounds.description: Revocation or suspension of the right to practice before any state or federal agency
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Revocation or suspension of the right of a licensee or substantial equivalency practitioner to practice before any state or federal agency

disciplinary_grounds.description: Dishonesty, fraud, professional negligence in the performance of services or willful departure from accepted standards of professional conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Dishonesty, fraud, professional negligence in the performance of services as a licensee or substantial equivalency practitioner or in the filing or failure to file the licensee's or substantial equivalency practitioner's own income tax returns, or a willful departure from accepted standards of professional conduct applicable to licensees and substantial equivalency practitioners

disciplinary_grounds.description: Violation of any provision of this article or any rule, including professional standards or rules of professional conduct
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Violation of any provision of this article or any rule, including the violation of any professional standard or rule of professional conduct

disciplinary_grounds.description: Conviction of a felony or any crime involving dishonesty or fraud
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Conviction of a felony or any crime an element of which is dishonesty or fraud under the laws of the United States or this state, or conviction of any similar crime under the laws of any other state

disciplinary_grounds.description: Performance of any fraudulent act by any licensee or substantial equivalency practitioner
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Performance of any fraudulent act by any licensee or substantial equivalency practitioner

disciplinary_grounds.description: Any conduct adversely reflecting upon the licensee's fitness to perform professional services
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Any conduct adversely reflecting upon the licensee's or substantial equivalency practitioner's fitness to perform professional services

disciplinary_grounds.description: Making any false or misleading statement or verification in support of an application for a license filed by another person or firm
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Making any false or misleading statement or verification in support of an application for a license filed by another person or firm

disciplinary_grounds.description: Engaging in the unlawful practice of law as defined by the West Virginia Supreme Court of Appeals
disciplinary_grounds.quote: Engaging in the unlawful practice of law as defined by the West Virginia Supreme Court of Appeals

definition_quote.value: Professional services means those services that involve the specialized knowledge and skills of a certified public accountant or a public accountant delivered by any means, including but not limited to, in person, by mail, telephone or by electronic means.
definition_quote.quote: "Professional services" means those services that involve the specialized knowledge and skills of a certified public accountant or a public accountant delivered by any means, including but not limited to, in person, by mail, telephone or by electronic means.

methods_authorized.quote: Performing services involving the use of accounting skills; rendering tax services, management advisory or consulting services; keeping of books of account and related accounting records; or preparing, compiling or assembling financial statements without the expression of an assurance.

value: Audit or other engagement in accordance with Statements on Auditing Standards (SAS)
Review of a financial statement in accordance with Statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS)
Examination of prospective financial information in accordance with Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE)
Engagement in accordance with Auditing Standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB)
Examination, review or agreed upon procedures engagement in accordance with Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE)
attest_services_types.quote: "Attest services" means providing the following services: (A) Any audit or other engagement to be performed in accordance with the statements on Auditing Standards (SAS); (B) Any review of a financial statement to be performed in accordance with the statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services (SSARS); (C) Any examination of prospective financial information to be performed in accordance with applicable Statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE); (D) Any engagement to be performed in accordance with the Auditing Standards of the Public Company Accounting Oversight Board (PCAOB); or (E) Any examination, review or agreed upon procedures engagement to be performed in accordance with the statements on Standards for Attestation Engagements (SSAE)

compilation_services_authorized.quote: "Compilation services" means providing a service performed in accordance with the statements on Standards for Accounting and Review Services that presents, in the form of a financial statement, information that is the representation of management without an expression of assurance on the statement

education_semester_hours_required.quote: At least one hundred fifty semester hours of college education including a baccalaureate or higher degree conferred by a college or university

exam_sit_hours_minimum.quote: before applying for the examination required by this subsection, an applicant is required to have met the baccalaureate degree requirement but not the one hundred fifty semester hour requirement of subsection (1) of this section

practice_privilege_no_notice_required.quote: An individual who offers or renders professional services under this section shall be granted practice privileges in this state, and no notice, fee, or other submission is required of any such individual.

value: Subject to jurisdiction of the board concerning all matters within the scope of this article
Required to comply with the provisions of this article and applicable rules
State board of accountancy of state of issuance appointed as agent for service of process
Must cease offering or rendering professional services if certificate from state of principal place of business is no longer valid
practice_privilege_consent_conditions.quote: Any individual performing or offering to perform any services in the state as a substantial equivalency practitioner and the firm which employs that out-of-state certificate holder are simultaneously subject to the jurisdiction of the board concerning all matters within the scope of this article and are required to comply with the provisions of this article and applicable rules.

attest_services_require_firm_permit.quote: an individual who qualifies for the practice privileges under this section may only perform any of the following services, for any entity with its home office in this state, through a firm which has obtained a permit issued under section seventeen of this article and an authorization issued under section nineteen of this article

firm_majority_cpa_ownership_required.quote: A simple majority of ownership of the firm, in terms of financial interests and voting rights of all partners, officers, shareholders, members or managers, belongs either to: (I) Certified public accountants holding a certificate under section twelve of this article or the equivalent provision of another state

nonlicensee_firm_owners_permitted.quote: All owners of the firm who are not certified public accountants or public accountants are active participants in the firm or in affiliated entities.

peer_review_required_for_firm_renewal.quote: The permit holder is undergoing a peer review program that conforms with applicable rules.

inactive_license_status_available.quote: Any certified public accountant receiving the exemption from continuing professional education requirements must place the word "inactive" adjacent to his or her "CPA" title on any business card, telephone directory listing, letterhead or any other similar document or device

retired_license_status_available.quote: a certified public accountant receiving the exemption from continuing professional education requirements who has completely discontinued his or her performance of professional services, who has no active management or supervisory responsibilities in a firm, and who is at least sixty-two years of age is not required to place the word "inactive" or any other word adjacent to his or her "CPA" title

out_of_state_firm_no_office_exemption.quote: A firm that does not have an office in this state may perform services described in subdivision (B), subsection (3), section two of this article, or subsection (12), section two of this article, for a client having its home office in this state and may use the title "CPA" or "CPA firm" without a permit issued under this section only if it meets firm ownership requirements and is undergoing a peer review program

attest_report_signer_competency_requirem.quote: Any certified public accountant, public accountant or substantial equivalency practitioner who signs or authorizes someone to sign an attest or compilation report on behalf of the permit holder meets the competency requirements set forth in the professional standards for those services specified by rule

working_papers_ownership_by_licensee.quote: Any statement, record, schedule, working paper, and memorandum made by a licensee or a partner, shareholder, officer, director, member, manager or employee of a licensee incident to, or in the course of, rendering services to a client while a licensee, remains the property of the licensee in the absence of an express agreement between the licensee and the client to the contrary

commission_prohibition_during_attest.quote: No licensee or substantial equivalency practitioner or firm may, for a commission or referral fee, recommend or refer to a client any product or service or refer any product or service to be supplied by a client, or perform for a contingent fee any professional services for or receive a referral fee, commission or contingent fee from a client for whom the licensee, the substantial equivalency practitioner or firm works or associates or in which either of them owns an interest or who performs for that client: (A) An audit or review of a financial statement

contingent_fee_prohibition_during_attest.quote: No licensee or substantial equivalency practitioner may for a contingent fee prepare an original or amended tax return or claim for a tax refund or serve as an expert witness.

safe_harbor_disclaimer_language_for_nonl.quote: The prohibitions of this section and the other provisions of this article may not be construed to preclude a person or business entity not holding a certificate or registration from using the following or substantially similar language: "I (We) have compiled the accompanying (financial statements)..."

single_act_evidence_sufficient.quote: evidence of the commission of a single act prohibited by this article is sufficient to justify a penalty, injunction, restraining order or conviction, respectively, without evidence of a general course of conduct.

firm_corrective_action_period_for_owners.quote: The board shall suspend or revoke the permit of any firm that ceases to meet firm ownership requirements due to changes in firm ownership or personnel due to the death or retirement of a partner, officer, shareholder, member or manager and that fails to take corrective action in the manner and during the time period specified by rule.

firm_permit_required_for_attest_services.quote: Any firm with an office in this state performing attest or compilation services

accounting_practitioner_tier.quote: "Public accountant" means a person holding a registration who is not a certified public accountant.

client_records_return_obligation.quote: a licensee shall furnish to a client or former client, upon request made within a reasonable time after original issuance of the document in question: (1) A copy of the tax return of the client; (2) A copy of any report or other document issued by the licensee to or for the client
